title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: Controls and Accessibility
sections.content: 1. Dedicated Scrolling Protocol: Arrow keys (Up, Down, Left, Right) and the Gamepad Right Analog Stick are exclusively assigned to viewport and list scrolling across all interfaces (Market catalog, Artisan recipes, Zen Library Bondex, and modal dialogs), fully detached from focus and movement mechanics. 2. Menu Item Focus & Navigation: W/S and Gamepad D-Pad (Up/Down) navigate item focus across menus (Title Screen, Market, Workbench, Rover Garage, and Bonsai Inspection actions), while A/D and Left/Right Bumpers (LB/RB) cleanly toggle modal categories and sub-tabs. E / Button A activates the focused selection. 3. Title Screen Keyboard Launch: Boot sequences automatically highlight the 'Enter Sanctuary' action, allowing immediate game start via E, Enter, Space, or Gamepad Button A without mouse input. 4. Excursion Return Protocol: Approaching the Basecamp extraction beacon and pressing E or Gamepad Button A completes the expedition, displays the debrief summary, and safely returns the rover and cargo to the Sanctuary.
sections.summary: Dedicated Arrow/Right-Stick Scrolling, Multi-Modal Menu Item Navigation, and Excursion Completion Protocol.
